bugs_found_and_fixed_by_this_milestone: a newly-visible peer got ordinary WireGuard connectivity (via the existing non-PQ peer diff) before the PQ engine had even discovered it, leaving a real window with no gate -- fixed by proactively gating every visible, not-yet-confirmed peer before the ordinary DeviceUpdate::apply, instead of only reactively gating once the engine's own Committed-phase install() ran (already too late by then)

that same proactive-gating step's first version iterated the ordinary peer list without excluding the coordination server's own entry; since the server never has a PQ relationship, it was classified unconfirmed and added to the blocked set, self-blocking the very link the PQ handshake needs to complete and hanging every subsequent request to the server on that interface -- fixed by excluding state.server_id/state.peer_id, the same way pq_sync::apply's own loop already does

the CLI's top-level error log used anyhow's Display ({}), which shows only a wrapped error's outermost context and hid the actual root cause while diagnosing the bug above -- changed to the alternate Display ({:#}) so the full chain is visible, a real improvement independent of the bug hunt
